problems.problem: The agent hallucinated that "Crane World" is a 1993 Russian film by Aleksei Uchitel (it is actually a 1999 Argentine film by Pablo Trapero).
The agent failed to explicitly formulate the required evidence document names as Wikipedia-style article titles in the reasoning text.
The agent completely failed to include the required lists "Retrieved required evidence documents" and "Missing required evidence documents".
The agent formulated a natural language question instead of a comprehensive search query or string of keywords.
